query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: A high entropy alloy coating can be used to adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix to enhance its wear resistance.
generation.intervention: Applying a high entropy alloy coating
generation.structural_mediator: Interfacial bonding between the Cu matrix and the high entropy alloy coating
generation.mechanism: The high entropy alloy coating provides a hard, wear-resistant surface layer that protects the underlying Cu matrix
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved wear resistance of the Cu matrix
generation.boundary: The high entropy alloy coating must be properly bonded to the Cu matrix to ensure effective wear resistance
generation.uncertainty: The specific composition and processing conditions of the high entropy alloy coating may affect its adhesion and wear resistance properties

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative wear testing of coated and uncoated Cu matrix samples
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the coated Cu matrix sample exhibits no significant improvement in wear resistance compared to the uncoated sample, the hypothesis is falsified
